summary: UI flow handler for the profile-create page. Pulls child control 3 out of the page control (this[16]) via its vtable and branches on whether the entered player name (byte_7CD818) passes the uniqueness check. If unique: optionally formats and shows a 'player name never used' message built from the settings directory, sanitizes the name, allocates and initializes a temporary UI control window, and on successful text-file load creates the profile (ShortComputation_92a0), tears down the window, triggers a follow-up (sub_4B0770) when v3[276] > 0, then runs profile file create/read and a final cleanup (ShortComputation_0ad0); result becomes 0. If the name already exists: copies the 'profile already' string into byte_5EC4CC, displays it on the page control, dispatches the profile-exists prompt (LookupDispatch with -1) and keeps result -1. Finally re-fetches two dispatch objects (3 and 45) from dword_7CD8C0 and calls their vtable methods, then returns the accumulated result.
